chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 226: Ji Ning Sets a Cold, Surgical Trap for a Snowdragon Mountain Retainer
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning executes a ruthless, calculated plan to lure a Zifu Disciple from the Water Clan into an ambush. He kidnaps the clan's chieftain and waits.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 226 – The Trap is Set
og_description: Ji Ning uses his divine sense to stalk prey, kidnaps a chieftain, and waits in the sky with cold patience. The hunter has locked his target.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's revenge arc turns clinical. Watch him bait a Zifu Disciple into a perfect kill-box.

lore_anchors.definition: A Human-ranked magic treasure used for capturing and transporting prisoners. It creates a powerful suction to draw in helpless targets, but cannot be used offensively on a resisting foe. Prisoners inside cannot breathe.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, so pure it can be absorbed instantly without burdening the body. It is a legendary cultivation resource.
A Xianxia concept where a cultivator's starting point, clan, and emotional bonds are considered part of their spiritual foundation. Leaving it behind is a form of tribulation.
The Grand Xia Dynasty’s elite immortal corps; requires at least Wanxiang Adept level to join.
The distant territory of the Dong Clan where Shui Yi serves as a retainer; far from his own Water Clan's home city.
